items.title: Add koala-residue preflight gate to review-preflight.ts
items.context: Add KOALA_RESIDUE_GATE_LABEL constant (string mirroring ENGLISH_ARTIFACTS_GATE_LABEL at review-preflight.ts:81: gate name + standalone repro). Add runKoalaResidueGate() helper that execFileSyncs node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs, captures exit code + stdout; returns pass/fail + first non-empty stdout line. Add to the PreflightGateName union type (review-preflight.ts:114) as the 7th name. Insert dispatch entry into the preflight gate list AFTER docs-drift, BEFORE codex-adapter conditional. Failed gate prints stdout (the hit lines) via the same path as english-artifacts BLOCK output.
items.userSees: lattice story_advance --phase=TEST prints a 7th gate line: '[✓] koala-residue: pass' (or '[✗] koala-residue: fail' with hit list). grep koala-residue packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts shows 3+ hits.

happy.desc: KOALA_RESIDUE_GATE_LABEL constant exists in review-preflight.ts -> `grep -c "KOALA_RESIDUE_GATE_LABEL" packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts` outputs at least 2 (declaration + usage); WHY: the constant must be declared AND used

PreflightGateName union type includes koala-residue -> `grep -c "koala-residue" packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts` outputs at least 3 (label string + union type + dispatch); WHY: gate name must be in TS type system

runKoalaResidueGate helper function defined -> `grep -c "function runKoalaResidueGate\|const runKoalaResidueGate" packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts` outputs at least 1; WHY: dispatch must have a concrete implementation
rebuilt dist contains koala-residue gate logic -> `grep -c koala-residue packages/main/dist/handlers/review-preflight.js` outputs at least 3; WHY: code must land in compiled output for runtime use

edge.desc: clean state: lattice story_advance does NOT fail on koala-residue gate when residue is absent -> `node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs; echo $?` outputs 0; WHY: gate must not false-fail on clean state

gate uses execFileSync with timeout -> `grep -E "execFileSync.*verify-koala-residue|timeout.*koala" packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts | wc -l` outputs at least 1; WHY: per pre-mortem D2, prevent hung subprocess

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs byte-identical to main -> `git diff main...HEAD -- scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: script is byte-frozen per constraint

OVER-REACH: other 6 gates untouched -> `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts | grep -cE "^-.*ENGLISH_ARTIFACTS_GATE|^-.*channel|^-.*concept|^-.*lint|^-.*docs-drift|^-.*codex-adapter"` outputs 0; WHY: only addition allowed, no removals

OVER-REACH: no validate-koala-residue.ts handler created (out per option a) -> `ls packages/main/src/handlers/validate-koala-residue.ts 2>&1 | grep -c "No such"` outputs at least 1; WHY: confirm option (a) preflight-only choice
